verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several of its own export paths: CSV downloads from analytics tables, one-click case information downloads, a Reports History export of case data including comments, and APIs for listing and fetching cases for data syncing. None of these is documented as a complete account-wide export, and only the analytics export names an open format (CSV). Missing for 10: a documented full-account or all-data export, stated open formats for case and attachment exports, offboarding or data-portability documentation, and independent corroboration.
